title: The Beginning of DeFiChain
text: DeFiChain was created with the vision to bring decentralized financial services to the Bitcoin ecosystem. The goal was to combine Bitcoin security with powerful DeFi applications.

title: Why Bitcoin?
text: DeFiChain was designed with a strong connection to Bitcoin. The idea was to use Bitcoin as a foundation while enabling decentralized finance features.

title: What is DFI?
text: DFI is the native token of DeFiChain. It powers governance, staking, rewards and many functions inside the ecosystem.

title: The DeFiChain DEX
text: The decentralized exchange allows users to trade digital assets without traditional intermediaries while staying within the DeFiChain ecosystem.

title: Community Governance
text: DeFiChain uses community voting to decide important changes. DFIPs allow the community to propose and vote on improvements.

title: The Community Fund
text: The Community Fund supports projects, development and initiatives that help grow the DeFiChain ecosystem.

title: dTokens
text: DeFiChain introduced dTokens as blockchain-based assets designed to represent different markets and financial instruments.

title: Staking on DeFiChain
text: Users can participate in network security and receive rewards through staking mechanisms.

title: DeFiChain and Decentralization
text: Decentralization is a core principle of DeFiChain, giving the community an important role in the future development.

title: The Vision of DeFiChain
text: The long-term vision is an open financial ecosystem where users can access decentralized services globally.
